body.name: \mathfrak H_{\mathrm{lb}}
body.construction: Build four subexperiments inside \(\mathcal M_n\): shell-localized treated-mean shifts for \(Q_{\kappa}\), an untreated-observation coupling at scale \(n^{-1/(\kappa+1)}\), a signed-cell fuzzy mixture at scale \(r_{en}^{2/(\kappa+2)}\) whose propensity tilt cancels its sign tilt in each treated observed row, and a control-side fuzzy mixture on a fixed band \(B=\{s_c<e_0\le 2s_c\}\) of the same perturbable active tail reservoir. For the control family, split \(B\) into \(N\) equal cells, put \(g_0=h_0Z_j\), \(h_0=c_A r_{0n}/\sqrt{P_X(B)}\), publicly supply \(m_0=0\) and \(p=e_0\), and set \(1-e_{\theta,Z}=(1-e_0)/(1+\theta tZ_j)\), where \(t=c_A\min\{r_{en}/\sqrt{P_X(B)},1/4\}\). Choose \(c_A\) from the fixed class constants so that every fixed-sign law preserves positivity, right overlap, both dyadic shell inequalities, the nuisance certificates, and the signal and outcome moments. In every family keep the public functions fixed across the hypotheses, bound mixture discrepancy by cell collisions, concentrate the random target, and combine the four component separations into \(\rho_n\) by the maximum-to-sum comparison.
